updated.name: Power Gifting
updated.rules: One ally gives your main personality power on a stage for stage basis, reducing their total and boosting your main personality's. Discard from the game after use.

updated.name: Terrible Wounds
updated.rules: Place this on a foe's personality card. Reset the personality's anger to (0). It cannot go up until after he forces another player to discard a life card. Discard this from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

updated.name: Plant Two Saibaimen
updated.rules: Use this card at the end of your Power Up step. Skip Combat this turn. At the beginning of your next turn, search your Life Deck and/or discard pile for your highest level Saibaimen card and place it into play. Remove from the game after use.
